Apple’s (AAPL) Buy Rating Reiterated at Rosenblatt Securities Posted by Anthony Miller | Mar 31st, 2018 
Rosenblatt Securities reiterated their buy rating on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a report issued on Friday, March 16th. Rosenblatt Securities currently has a $180.00 price objective on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
Other equities analysts also recently issued reports about the stock. BidaskClub downgraded shares of Apple from a hold rating to a sell rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. BMO Capital Markets downgraded shares of Apple from an outperform rating to a market perform rating and lifted their price objective for the stock from $162.00 to $166.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 31st. William Blair reaffirmed an outperform rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, February 2nd. Bank of America reaffirmed an outperform rating and set a $220.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, February 8th. Finally, Longbow Research downgraded shares of Apple from a buy rating to a neutral rating in a report on Wednesday, January 17th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has an average rating of Buy and a consensus target price of $202.62. Get Apple alerts: 
NASDAQ AAPL opened at $167.78 on Friday. Apple has a 12-month low of $140.06 and a 12-month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The firm has a market capitalization of $851,317.94, a P/E ratio of 18.22, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.27 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $3.36 EPS. sell-side analysts expect that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this link . 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.

Endurance Wealth Management Inc. now owns 79,511 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $11,451,000 after purchasing an additional 1,850 shares during the period. Northstar Wealth Partners LLC now owns 16,278 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,361,000 after purchasing an additional 578 shares during the period. Finally, Alley Co LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 1.1% during the second quarter. Alley Co LLC now owns 39,286 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,658,000 after purchasing an additional 437 shares during the period. 61.35% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
